subject: Family Reunion Planning
body: Dear family members, I hope this email finds you well. As we approach the end of the year, I wanted to start planning our next family reunion. I suggest we gather at the usual park for a potluck picnic on the first Saturday of next month. Please reply to this email with your availability and any food preferences. Let's make this reunion a memorable one filled with laughter and good food! Looking forward to seeing everyone soon.
